convergence.description: Gates config-done on the OSPF triangle converging. Device-keyed across the two FRR-based flavors; every address and router ID renders from the fact namespace.

ospf_adjacency.description: Each router holds two Full adjacencies (its two triangle peers), asserted in each platform's own idiom.

ospf_peers_json.description: parse=json + compare: r1 sees both peers converged Full, by router IDs rendered from facts — the panel's worked example of a compare diff.

reachability.description: The control plane agreeing is not the data plane working: cross-fabric loopback pings, run on demand from the Tests tab.

loopback_ping.description: r1 (VyOS) pings r3's loopback and r3 (FRR) pings r1's — both directions of the fabric FIB. The FRR flavor asserts on '0% packet loss': its image's busybox ping prints 'N packets received' where iputils prints 'N received'.
